name: gitflow-changelog
description: Gitflow-aware changelog generator, packaged as a GitHub Action

scripts.build: npm run build:cli && npm run build:action
scripts.build:cli: esbuild src/cli.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node20 --format=esm --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);" --outfile=dist/cli.js
scripts.build:action: esbuild src/action.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node20 --format=esm --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);" --outfile=dist/index.js
